global_fail_closed_rules: UNKNOWN, CLAIMED, or CONFLICTING authentication, containment, identity, privacy, cost, or certification does not map to unattended execution.
Mechanical validation remains the only currently observed automatic lane.
No credential-bearing generic self-hosted runner is permitted.
No environment failure automatically selects a stronger, more expensive, or less private route.
No model, broker, runner, adapter, or publisher receives merge, release, or governance authority.
Automatic routing waits for shadow evaluation and route certification.
